description: This file contains unit tests for the ClaimDao class within the OrangeHRM system, specifically testing CRUD operations and other functionalities related to claim events, expense types, and claim requests in the claim plugin.

classes.name: ClaimDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ClaimDao, testing methods for claim event management, expense types, and claim requests.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ClaimDao instance and populates test data from fixture.

methods.name: testSaveEvent
methods.description: Tests saving a new claim event and verifies its name and status.

methods.name: testGetClaimEventList
methods.description: Tests retrieving the list of claim events and verifies expected event presence.

methods.name: testGetClaimEventById
methods.description: Tests fetching a claim event by its ID and verifies its name.

methods.name: testDeleteClaimEvents
methods.description: Tests deleting claim events by their IDs and verifies the delete count.

methods.name: testCountClaimEvents
methods.description: Tests counting claim events with different filters.

methods.name: testSaveExpenseType
methods.description: Tests saving an expense type and verifies name and user ID.

methods.name: testSaveClaimRequest
methods.description: Tests saving a claim request, involving associated claim event and currency type, and verifies the claim event name.

methods.name: testGetNextId
methods.description: Tests retrieving the next available ID for claims.

methods.name: testIsClaimEventUsed
methods.description: Tests whether a claim event is used elsewhere or not.
